Triage 5 SC2043 single-iteration loops (disable with symmetry-for-growth reason x5)

Re-run Phase 3 class filter to confirm no regression

approaches_tried.approach: mapfile replacement of IFS=$'\n' x=($(cmd)) word-splitting idiom
approaches_tried.reason: An unconditional mapfile <<< sort of an empty joined array reads back one empty-string element instead of staying zero-length (export-to-markdown.sh root_files/dir_files); guarded with a non-empty check before mapfile to preserve exact original semantics. zotero-attach-chunks.sh had no such risk since chunk_files was already confirmed non-empty by a preceding guard.
